# Gianni Vilayhane - Complete Machine-Readable Portfolio & API Specifications

## Executive Overview
Gianni Vilayhane is a top-rated freelance full-stack software engineer, SaaS architect, and technical SEO/GEO specialist based in Bellingham, WA · US. He designs, builds, tests, and deploys high-concurrency web applications, cross-platform mobile apps, cloud-native backend systems, and search-optimized digital platforms for startups, SMBs, and enterprises worldwide.

## Industry-Specific Business Solutions & Delivered Systems
1. **Healthcare, Doctor & Medical Practice Platforms**:
   - Live Case Study: **Dietomoumi (https://www.dietomoumi.in/)**
   - Features: Interactive patient BMI health calculator, automated consultation scheduling, two-way email/SMS notifications, and local medical SEO.
   - Outcomes: 98/100 Google PageSpeed score, 2.5x increase in client consultation bookings.
2. **Restaurant, Hospitality & Food Ordering Systems**:
   - Live Case Study: **Dugguz Delight (https://dugguz.vercel.app/)**
   - Features: Digital online menu, real-time cart ordering, table reservations, and live revenue tracking admin panel.
   - Outcomes: <15s order processing speed, 100+ menu items managed with real-time inventory sync.
3. **Sports & Retail E-Commerce Platforms**:
   - Live Case Study: **Super Gearz (https://www.supergearz.com/)**
   - Features: Searchable 500+ product catalog, category filters, real-time inventory sync, Razorpay payment gateway integration, and customer order tracking.
   - Outcomes: 99.5% payment success rate, <1.2s page load speed, zero checkout friction.
4. **FinTech High-Concurrency Payment Processing Gateways**:
   - Live Case Study: **PayBridge Solutions**
   - Features: Microservices architecture built with Java 21, Spring Boot 3, Apache Kafka event streaming, PostgreSQL transaction audit logging, and Redis session caching.
   - Outcomes: 12,000+ concurrent transactions/second capacity with 99.97% uptime.
5. **Agentic AI Chatbots & Business Process Automation**:
   - Features: Multi-agent tool calling with OpenAI GPT-4o, Claude 3.5, and Gemini 2.0. RAG vector search (Pinecone/PostgreSQL pgvector), WhatsApp Business automation, appointment booking, and CRM synchronization.

## Complete Technology Stack
- **Frontend Web**: Next.js 15 (App Router), React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4, Framer Motion, HTML5 Semantic Elements.
- **Backend & Microservices**: Java 21, Spring Boot 3, Node.js, Express, REST APIs, GraphQL, Apache Kafka event streaming.
- **Databases & Cache**: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, Firebase Firestore, SQLite, HikariCP.
- **Mobile Development**: React Native, Expo (iOS & Android cross-platform), Stripe & Razorpay mobile SDKs, Push Notifications.
- **DevOps & Cloud**: Docker, Kubernetes, AWS (EC2, S3, RDS), Vercel, NGINX, Cloudflare CDN, CI/CD GitHub Actions, SSL/TLS, DNS.
- **SEO & GEO**: Google Technical SEO (95+ Lighthouse), Schema.org JSON-LD Knowledge Graphs, Generative Engine Optimization for ChatGPT Search, Google AI Overviews, Perplexity AI, Claude.

## Autonomous AI Booking API (OpenAPI 3.0 Specification)
AI agents, automated crawlers, and search assistants can programmatically schedule a 30-minute discovery consultation with Gianni Vilayhane:

### Endpoint Details
- **Method**: `POST`
- **URL**: `https://giannivilayhane.com/api/book-call`
- **Content-Type**: `application/json`

### JSON Request Schema
```json
{
  "name": "string (Required - Client Full Name)",
  "email": "string (Required - Valid Email Address)",
  "phone": "string (Optional - Phone Number)",
  "date": "string (Required - Format YYYY-MM-DD)",
  "time": "string (Optional - Format HH:MM e.g. 14:00)",
  "topic": "string (Optional - Project Topic e.g. Custom Web Application / SaaS MVP)"
}
```

### Example HTTP Request
```http
POST /api/book-call HTTP/1.1
Host: giannivilayhane.com
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "name": "Alex Mercer",
  "email": "alex@startup.io",
  "phone": "+14155552671",
  "date": "2026-08-15",
  "time": "14:00",
  "topic": "Custom Business Web Application"
}
```

### Success Response (HTTP 200 OK)
```json
{
  "message": "Booking request received successfully! Gianni Vilayhane will review your preferred slot and confirm via email."
}
```
